text: Manchester City 's Norwegian striker Erling Haaland, 26, does not have a clause in his contract with the club in the event of relegation or any other circumstances. (Sport - in Spanish)
Manchester City , Liverpool and Chelsea are interested in Spain midfielder Marcos Llorente, 31, who is yet to decide his future with Atletico Madrid . (TeamTalk)
The same three Premier League clubs are keeping an eye on Inter Milan and Italy defender Alessandro Bastoni, 27, who is also attracting interest from Barcelona . (TeamTalk)

Brentford are in discussions with their winger Kevin Schade about a new long-term contract amid increasing interest in the Germany international from clubs including Arsenal and Liverpool . (Sky Sports)
Brighton are planning to trigger an extension in the contract of 22-year-old Sweden midfielder Yasin Ayari in the coming weeks. (Football Insider)
Liverpool are giving serious consideration to making 27-year-old Uruguay defender Ronald Araujo's loan switch from Barcelona a permanent one. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Juventus have been offered the chance to sign Crystal Palace defender Tyrick Mitchell, 27, amid other interest from Liverpool and Manchester United in the Englishman. (Tuttosport - in Italian)
Real Madrid are interested in Stuttgart's 20-year-old Germany U21s centre-back Finn Jeltsch. (AS - in Spanish)

Nottingham Forest and Aston Villa both made enquiries over the availability of France youth international Valentin Atangana. The 21-year-old is currently with Saudi club Al-Ahli. (L'Equipe - in French - subscription required)
Newcastle sporting director Ross Wilson is overseeing a new recruitment approach which will see the club prioritising young talent and a new player trading strategy. (The I - subscription required)
Chelsea will head the queue if Bournemouth 's English midfielder Alex Scott, 23, becomes available in January. (Mail - subscription required)
Bayern Munich are eyeing a potential January move for Barcelona forward Dani Olmo, 28, with a valuation of about £60m for World Cup-winning Spaniard. (Sky Sports)
England midfielder Jude Bellingham, 23, will extend his contract at Real Madrid and is not interested in a move to Manchester City . (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Atalanta and Italy defender Giorgio Scalvini, 22, is the subject of interest from Tottenham , Newcastle and Chelsea . (Caught Offside)

Chelsea and Aston Villa do not have a January exit clause in the deal that took Argentina winger Alejandro Garnacho, 22, to the Midlands club on a season-long loan at. (Telegraph - subscription required)

Liverpool are considering a move to bring 23-year-old English midfielder Tyler Morton back to the club from Lyon, with Nottingham Forest , Crystal Palace and Brighton also keeping tabs on him. (Teamtalk)
Chelsea are one of four Premier League clubs keeping a close eye on Manchester City and Uzbekistan defender Abdukodir Khusanov, 22. (Caught Offside)
Juventus could be set to reignite their interest in Brazil goalkeeper Alisson, 33, whose future at Liverpool is in doubt. (Football Italia)
Barcelona will need to sell players in January to fund any incoming transfers, with Inter Milan and Italy defender Alessandro Bastoni, 27, on their shortlist. (Fichajes - in Spanish)

Barcelona have ruled out signing Argentina forward Julian Alvarez from Atletico Madrid in January, with the 24-year-old waiting to see whether Paris St-Germain or Arsenal make a bid for him, or whether he should stay put. (Fichajes - in Spanish)

Liverpool will not countenance selling Germany midfielder Florian Wirtz, 23, to Bayern Munich in the January transfer window, while the German giants would only consider making a move next summer if France winger Michael Olise, 24, turns down a new deal. (Christian Falk - Bayern Insider/Bild)

Bournemouth 's Alex Scott, 23, and Crystal Palace and England's Adam Wharton, 22, are Chelsea 's primary midfield targets, with the West London club no longer interested in Monaco and Senegal's Lamine Camara, 22. ( CaughtOffside )
Aston Villa are keen to tie Argentina midfielder Emi Buendia, 29, to a new contract as a reward for his outstanding form (Mail)
England left-back Luke Shaw, 31, could leave Manchester United when his present deal expires with the club next summer. (Teamtalk)
Udinese are set to sign Austria defender David Alaba, 34, who left Real Madrid in the summer. (Fabrizio Romano)
Crystal Palace 's English left-back Tyrick Mitchell, 27, is attracting growing interest from Manchester United and Liverpool . (Teamtalk)

Aston Villa attacking midfielder Alejandro Garnacho is being monitored by clubs in La Liga after struggling to make an impression at Villa Park following his summer loan switch from Chelsea . (Mail plus - subscription required)

Julian Ward is set to be reappointed as Liverpool 's sporting director. The 45-year-old will switch from his current role as Fenway Sports Group's technical director to replace Richard Hughes in a position he previously held during the 2022-23 season. (The Athletic)
Bayern Munich are interested in Nottingham Forest 's England midfielder Morgan Gibbs-White, 26. (Talksport)
Arsenal will use the September international break to finalise details over a new long-term contract for England midfielder Declan Rice, 27. (Football Transfers)

The Gunners have the option to extend Rice's current deal by 12 months but would like to tie him to a long-term deal in keeping with the club policy towards players seen as key by Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta. (Guardian)
Liverpool remain firmly committed to bringing the best out of Germany attacking midfielder Florian Wirtz, 23, despite the player's representatives being sounded out by Bayern Munich . (Teamtalk)

Chelsea are tracking highly rated Gambian 15-year-old midfielder Adama Jeng with Bayern Munich , Benfica , Sporting and Paris FC also interested in the Samger FC youngster. (Mail plus - subscription required)
AC Milan and Roma are keen on a loan deal for Real Madrid's 20-year-old forward Endrick if Bernabeu president Florentino Perez is willing to let the Brazilian leave. (Calciomercato - in Italian)
Barcelona have scouted Athletico Paranaense's 19-year-old Brazilian Arthur Dias who was the subject of previous strong interest from Tottenham . (ESPN Brasil - in Portuguese)

Arsenal came so close to signing Brazil forward Vinicius Jr from Real Madrid in the summer that the 26-year-old's team-mates thought it was a foregone conclusion he would join the Gunners. (Cadena SER - in Spanish)
Liverpool are continuing to monitor 20-year-old Feyenoord right-back Givairo Read but Manchester City and Arsenal are also interested in the Netherlands Under-21 international. (Teamtalk)
Brazilian forward Raphinha, 29, wants to stay at Barcelona and initial talks have taken place about a new contract, with his current deal expiring in 2028. (AS - in Spanish)
Tottenham will not pursue a move to sign 33-year-old Argentine striker Mauro Icardi who is available on a free transfer. (Football Insider)
Brighton & Hove Albion and Aston Villa are both interested in signing Nacional's 18-year-old Paraguay wonderkid Mauro Coronel. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle will target a youthful centre-half and a right-sided forward in the January transfer window and beyond. (The I)
Barcelona are set to put a £428m (500m euro) buyout clause in the new contract being offered to 19-year-old Spanish midfielder Marc Bernal. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)

Tottenham Hotspur have set their sights on a possible £125m January move for Nottingham Forest star Morgan Gibbs-White, 26, after nearly signing the England international during the 2025 summer transfer window. (Football Insider)
Manchester United are looking at Lens' Portugal youth international midfielder Mezian Mesloub, 16, as they bid to strengthen their young talent pool. (Teamtalk)

The Old Trafford outfit remain keen to keep wantaway English forward JJ Gabriel, 15, who has been linked with a move to Real Madrid and Barcelona , with Chelsea now joining the battle to sign the teenager. (Teamtalk)

Manchester United are monitoring Italian manager Antonio Conte, 57, as a possible replacement for current boss Michael Carrick, should the former England international's position at the club become untenable. (Hard Tackle)
AC Milan and Juventus are also keeping tabs on Conte, who is waiting on the right opportunity to begin his next project after leaving Napoli in the summer. (Calciomercato - in Italian)
Atletico Madrid have reignited their interest in Bayer Leverkusen's young sensation Ibrahim Maza, 20, as they look to strengthen their midfield. (Goal)
Liverpool , Manchester City , Fulham , and Tottenham are among several Premier League clubs monitoring 24-year-old Venezula and Real Sociedad defender Jon Aramburu. (Teamtalk)
Liverpool have held initial talks with Monaco and Senegal midfielder Lamine Camara, 22, over a potential January move. (Caughtoffside)
Arsenal are interested in 23-year-old Borussia Dortmund and Germany forward Maximilian Beier. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle face competition from Barcelona for Djurgarden and Norway midfielder Bo Hegland, 22. (Football Insider)
Arsenal are keen on a January move for Brazil and Real Madrid forward Endrick. Concerns are growing over the 20-year-old's game time in the Spanish capital. (Teamtalk)
Liverpool are expecting offers for German midfielder Florian Wirtz in January. They have no intention to let the 23-year-old leave. (Football Insider)
Barcelona are still interested in Manchester City forward Erling Haaland and could launch a huge offer for the 26-year-old Norwegian next year. (Football Insider)
Tottenham have rejected an offer from UAE side Shabab Al Ahli for Brazil forward Richarlison, 29. (Ekrem Konur on X)
Juventus and Atletico Madrid are monitoring Arsenal 's 24-year-old winger Noni Madueke before a potential move in the January transfer window. (Football London)
Liverpool and Manchester City are keen on Real Sociedad and Venezuala defender Jon Aramburu, 24. (Teamtalk)
Paris St-Germain forwards Ousmane Dembele, 29, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, 25, and Desire Doue, 21, are all in negotiations to sign new contracts in the French capital. (L'Equipe - in French)
Juventus could move for a free agent goalkeeper after losing Polish loan signing Kamil Grabara, 27, to a torn ACL, suffered in training on Saturday. (Calciomercato - in Italian)

Liverpool watched £51.5m-rated Netherlands midfielder Kees Smit when AZ Alkmaar faced Sunderland in the Europa League this week - with Chelsea , Tottenham , Nottingham Forest and Aston Villa also among the clubs keeping tabs on the 20-year-old. (Teamtalk)
Manchester United are monitoring the performances of 24-year-old Everton and England defender Jarrad Branthwaite. (Football Insider)

Tottenham are leading the race to sign 19-year-old Brazil defender Arthur Dias from Athletico Paranaense, while Newcastle United , Nottingham Forest and Brentford are also monitoring the defender, who is valued at 30m euros . (Teamtalk)
Monaco have confirmed plans to sell United States striker Folarin Balogun in January after the 25-year-old changed his mind over a move to Everton on deadline day. (Standard)
Several European clubs are monitoring English 20-year-old defender Josh Acheampong's situation at Chelsea . (AS)
Monaco have admitted that a deal for 22-year-old midfielder Lamine Camara could be possible in January, with Liverpool and Chelsea interested in the Senegal international. (Standard)
Real Madrid will go all out to sign Morocco's new midfield gem Abdellah Ouazane, 17, who is at Ajax . (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Newcastle United are set to revive their interest in Djurgarden midfielder Bo Hegland after the 22-year-old Norwegian opted against moving in the summer. (Football Insider)
Arsenal , Brighton and Aston Villa are all monitoring Sturm Graz midfielder Luca Weinhandl, 17, with the Austrian valued at £20m. (Teamtalk)
Tottenham are considering signing free agent Mauro Icardi after the Argentine left Galatasaray, but they will not be able to register the 33-year-old until January. (Express)
Manchester City and Liverpool are keen on signing Germany midfielder Felix Nmecha, 25, with Borussia Dortmund expected to ask for 80-90m euros. (Fussball News)
Chelsea have joined a number of European clubs in the race to sign The Gambia youth international Adama Jeng, 15, from Norwegian side Tromso IL. (Football Insider)
Arsenal are extremely keen on a move for Bournemouth and France Under-21s forward Eli Junior Kroupi, 20, but the Cherries would expect a huge fee. (Football London)
Real Madrid are weighing up a move for Everton 's 24-year-old English defender Jarrad Branthwaite, who is also on the radar of several Premier League clubs. (Goal)
Chelsea are keen to explore a £69m deal for Spain and Athletic Bilbao winger Nico Williams, 24. (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Arsenal have no intention of selling 27-year-old Spanish midfielder Martin Zubimendi in January. (Football Insider)
Real Madrid and Barcelona have made fresh enquiries about American teenager Cavan Sullivan, 16, who is set to move to Manchester City from Philadelphia Union when he turns 18. (Teamtalk)

Liverpool will have to pay the full £130m release clause to buy 20-year-old Brazilian Rayan from Bournemouth despite manager Andoni Iraola's relationship with the midfielder from his time as Cherries boss. (ESPN Brazil via Caught Offside)

Atletico Madrid and Argentina midfielder Julian Alvarez, 26, who counts Arsenal and Barcelona among his suitors, is considering leaving his long-term agent after a summer of transfer speculation. (Mundo Deportivo)
Everton are unlikely to pursue Tottenham and Brazil forward Richarlison despite the 29-year-old being linked with a return to the Toffees over the summer. (Football Insider)
League One Luton Town approached Arsenal on multiple occasions regarding a loan deal for 16-year-old English attacker Max Dowman. (Talksport)
Luke Shaw could leave Manchester United next summer, with no indication of contract discussions between the club and the 31-year-old England defender at present. (Mail – subscription required)
However, German midfielder Noah Ajayi, 17, is close to signing his first professional contract with Manchester United . (Sky Sports)
Arsenal , Brighton , and Aston Villa are all monitoring 17-year-old Austrian midfielder Luca Weinhandl, who could be available from Sturm Graz for around £17m. (CaughtOffside)
Liverpool are considering a January move for 22-year-old Monaco and Senegal midfielder Lamine Camara, who missed out on a deadline-day move to Chelsea . (Football Insider)
Tottenham are the latest club to be linked to Argentine striker Mauro Icardi, with the 33-year-old available as a free agent after leaving Galatasaray in July. (Calciomercato – in Italian)
Arsenal are monitoring 25-year-old Real Madrid winger Rodrygo's recovery from injury, having previously expressed interest in the Brazilian over the summer. (Teamtalk)
English striker Vincent Joseph has confirmed his departure from Liverpool , with the 16-year-old expected to join Arsenal . (Standard)
Leeds United will not rush into turning Eintracht Frankfurt forward Jean-Matteo Bahoya's loan into a permanent deal. They have the option to buy the French 21-year-old for £19.7m. (Football Insider)
Former Manchester United and France forward Anthony Martial, 30, is set to join La Liga side Malaga as a free agent. (Footmercato – in Spanish)

Barcelona are looking at England and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane, 33, and Manchester City 's 26-year-old Norway international Erling Haaland as alternatives to Atletico Madrid and Argentina forward Julian Alvarez, 26. (Talksport)
Bayern Munich have been linked with 24-year-old Newcastle United and Germany forward Nick Woltemade - currently on loan at Juventus - as a potential replacement for Kane. (Talksport)
Manchester United have their sights on Everton and England defender Jarrad Branthwaite, 24, again after his return to action following injury problems. (Football Insider)
English winger Rio Ngumoha, 18, is on Arsenal 's radar but Liverpool want to extend his long-term contract. (Athletic - subscription required)

Tottenham remain interested in England and Nottingham Forest midfielder Morgan Gibbs-White, having previously tried to sign the 26-year-old in summer 2025, but Forest have no intention of selling. (Teamtalk)
Real Madrid striker Endrick could be available in the January transfer window, with Manchester United among those interested in the Brazilian 20-year-old. (AS via Teamtalk)

Spain midfielder Rodri, 30, spoke to Real Madrid boss Jose Mourinho "to thank him for his interest and the way he treated me" after joining Barcelona instead of the Bernabeu club from Manchester City in the summer. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)

Barcelona sporting director Deco held a meeting with Brazil international Raphinha, who is under contract until 2028, to discuss extending the 29-year-old forward's deal with the club. (Sport - in Spanish)
AC Milan's option to turn 22-year-old English forward Omari Hutchinson's loan move from Nottingham Forest into a permanent switch is close to 50m euros (£42.8m). (Calciomercato - in Italian)
Atletico Madrid and Juventus are considering a January loan move for Arsenal and England forward Noni Madueke, 24. ( Caught Offside )
Liverpool , Bayern Munich and Real Madrid are all interested in bolstering their midfield with PSV Eindhoven's 20-year-old Austrian international Paul Wanner. ( Teamtalk )
Lazio have resumed talks with Argentine striker Mauro Icardi, who is a free agent after leaving Galatasaray, and the 33-year-old is open to the move. (Sky Sports Italia)
Everton have also been linked with Icardi but Toffees boss David Moyes is reluctant to enter the free-agent market at present. (Football Insider)
Crystal Palace are aiming to tie England goalkeeper Dean Henderson, 29, to a new contract. ( The Athletic - subscription required )
Nottingham Forest will sign Shamrock Rovers striker Michael Noonan, 18, for training compensation in January. ( Irish Mirror )
Inter Milan are in talks to extend the contracts of Italy left-sided player Federico Dimarco, 28, and Turkey midfielder Hakan Calhanoglu, 32. (Football Italia)
Former France forward Karim Benzema, 38, has spoken with players at Bayer Leverkusen as he seeks a new club after leaving Al-Hilal in the summer. ( Fichajes - in Spanish )
Bayern Munich are keeping a close eye on the situation of Germany midfielder Florian Wirtz, 23, at Liverpool. (Teamtalk)

Liverpool could break their transfer record to sign Bournemouth 's Brazil forward Rayan, 20, next summer, should they choose to meet a £130m release cause that will become active in 2027. (Football Insider)
Liverpool have a 55m euros (£47.2m) option to turn their loan deal for Uruguay defender Ronald Araujo, 27, into a permanent move from Barcelona . (Fabrizio Romano via Caught Offside)

Juventus are not prepared to sell Pierre Kalulu in the January transfer window, with Manchester United and Liverpool both linked with a possible move for the 26-year-old France defender. (Manchester Evening News)
Borussia Dortmund boss Niko Kovac has ruled out the possibility of re-signing 26-year-old former Manchester United winger Jadon Sancho, with the Englishman a free agent. (Mirror)
Sancho's agent has held talks with multiple Premier League clubs over a potential move. (Football Insider)
Borussia Dortmund have joined Manchester United in showing interest in Leicester City midfielder Louis Page, with the German club sending scouts to watch the 18-year-old Englishman. (Teamtalk)
Championship clubs and Celtic are eyeing a move for England youth international and Liverpool defender Luke Chambers, 22, in January. (Football Insider)
Former Inter Milan sporting director Piero Ausilio is set to join Tottenham, who have offered the 54-year-old Italian a role from the January transfer window. (Gazzetta)
Arsenal are monitoring the progress of Como's Argentina forward Nico Paz, 22, but Real Madrid hold a buy-back option of 80m euros (£68.7m). (ElDesmarque - in Spanish)
Liverpool and Aston Villa are among the clubs tracking Fiorentina's Italy midfielder Cher Ndour, 22. (Caught Offside)
Sunderland are refusing to give up on signing Geny Catamo from Sporting after failing to sign the Mozambique winger, 25, in the summer. (Record, via Sport Witness)

Monaco believe they can get 70m euros (£60.1m) for Chelsea and Liverpool target Lamine Camara, the 22-year-old Senegal midfielder who saw a move to Stamford Bridge collapse on deadline day. (TeamTalk)
Germany forward Lukas Nmecha, 25, will look to leave Leeds United when his contract expires at the end of this season if he is not given more game time. (Football Insider)
Celtic are keeping tabs on Liverpool 's English left-back Luke Chambers, 22, as they weigh up a potential move in the January transfer window. (Football Insider)
Ivory Coast winger Wilfried Zaha, 33, has been offered to Malaga having left Galatasaray as a free agent after two spells on loan with MLS team Charlotte FC . (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Raphinha is under contract at Barcelona until 2028 but the Spanish champions are already considering offering the Brazil winger, 29, an extension until 2030. (AS - in Spanish)
Barca have also finalised an extension for 18-year-old Egypt forward Hamza Abdelkarim to 2030, with a release clause of 150m euros (£128.7m). (Sport - in Spanish)
Arsenal and Chelsea are leading the charge for Valerenga's 15-year-old Norwegian winger Gabriel Rajkovic. (TeamTalk)
Clubs remain interested in Brazil forward Richarlison, 29, after the collapse of his proposed move from Tottenham to Vasco da Gama . (UOL - in Portuguese)

Former Brazil forward Philippe Coutinho has agreed to spend three months with Santos as the 34-year-old, once of Liverpool and Aston Villa , decides whether he wants to keep playing having been a free agent since February when he left Vasco da Gama . (Globo - in Portuguese)
Manchester United are closely monitoring Bournemouth 's Adrien Truffert, the 24-year-old France left-back who is valued at £60m. (Teamtalk)
Liverpool remain keen on Inter Milan's Aleksandar Stankovic after making an enquiry about the 21-year-old Serbia midfielder this summer. (Teamtalk)
Crystal Palace have not given up on Brest's 20-year-old French centre-back Raphael le Guen, who they tried to sign in the summer. (Ouest-France via SportWitness)
Liverpool are still interested in France winger Michael Olise, 24, but Bayern Munich would not sell him in January. (Christian Falk)
Lamine Camara is focused on Monaco after the collapse of his deadline-day move to Chelsea and the Senegal midfielder, 22, says "maybe other opportunities will come along". (ESPN)
Jadon Sancho is not expected to join a new club imminently as the former England winger, 26, continues to weigh up his options after leaving Manchester United in June. (Football Insider)

Lazio and Parma have joined Everton in expressing an interest in former Argentina striker Mauro Icardi, 33, who is a free agent after leaving Galatasaray in the summer. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Malaga are considering signing ex- Manchester United and France forward Anthony Martial, 30, who is a free agent after leaving Mexican club Monterrey in June. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Martin Zubimendi may push to leave Arsenal in January after losing his place in the XI, with Chelsea and Real Madrid interested in the 27-year-old Spain midfielder. (Teamtalk)
Argentine striker and free agent Mauro Icardi, 33, is open to moving to Everton after leaving Galatasary in July. (Teamtalk)

However, sources at Everton have played down links to Icardi and fellow free agent Anthony Martial. The 30-year-old France forward last played for Mexican side Monterrey. (i Paper - subscription required)

Liverpool were interested in 21-year-old Italy defender Marco Palestra, who later moved from Atalanta to Chelsea , but were hampered by needing to strengthen in other areas. (The Athletic - subscription required)
Real Madrid have offered 21-year-old Turkish midfielder Arda Guler, who counts Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso among his admirers, a six-year contract. (Fabrizio Romano via Teamtalk)
Newcastle target and Italy defender Giorgio Scalvini, 22, has signed a new long-term contract with Atalanta. (Fabrizio Romano)
Aston Villa are in talks with Netherlands left-back Ian Maatsen, 24, over a new contract at Villa Park. ( Football Insider )
Crystal Palace striker Eddie Nketiah, 27, is considering switching his international allegiance from England to Ghana. (The Standard)
Colombian striker Kevin Viveros, 26, is nearing a new deal with Athletico Paranaense after attracting interest from Sunderland and Aston Villa over the summer. (ESPN Brazil via Sunderland Echo)

Newcastle could still sell Lewis Hall next summer despite the 22-year-old England left-back, recently linked with a move to Manchester United , reportedly agreeing a new contract with the Magpies until 2031. ( Talksport )

Lisandro Martinez, 28, will be offered a new long-term contract by Manchester United if the Argentina centre-back stays injury-free and has an impressive 2026-27 season at Old Trafford. ( Football Insider )
Brighton are confident a new contract for Sweden midfielder Yasin Ayari, 22, can be agreed soon with positive talks ongoing. ( Teamtalk )

Kaoru Mitoma's future at Brighton is, however, in the balance as the Japan winger, 29, is unlikely to extend his contract which expires next summer and could make an exit as soon as the January window. ( Teamtalk )

After failing to sign France midfielder Manu Kone in the summer, Chelsea could go back for the 25-year-old AS Roma player in January in a deal that could also involve English winger Jamie Gittens, 22, heading in the opposite direction. ( Simon Phillips, via CaughtOffside )
Liverpool have plans to sign another midfielder next summer, which would push Argentina international Alexis Mac Allister, 27, further down the pecking order at Anfield. ( Talksport )
Atletico Madrid are not planning to sell Spain midfielder Alex Baena, 25, anytime soon despite interest from Manchester City . ( Football Insider )
Manchester United and Tottenham both had representatives in Belgium on Tuesday to watch Club Brugge's German striker Nicolo Tresoldi, 22. ( Teamtalk )
Austria defender David Alaba is a possible target for Mexican side Club America after the 34-year-old left Real Madrid in the summer. ( Fichajes - in Spanish )
Liverpool and Manchester United are monitoring Germany defender Malick Thiaw, but Newcastle have no intention of selling the 25-year-old. (Caught Offside)
Sunderland winger Chemsdine Talbi. 21, is close to agreeing a deal to sign for Saudi Pro League side Al-Ittihad . (Football Insider)
Fulham are expected to begin contract talks with 26-year-old defender Calvin Bassey, who is attracting interest from Inter Milan . (Teamtalk)
Bournemouth winger Rayan, 20, has a £130m release clause that takes effect in the 2027 summer transfer window. (David Ornstein via the Athletic - subscription required)
Midfielder Joe Willock, 27, will be offered a new contract by Newcastle if he continues to perform well under Matthias Jaissle. (Football Insider)
Former Real Madrid midfielder James Rodriguez, 35, is in talks to sign for Serie B side Avellino , who are managed by former Italy defender Alessandro Nesta. (Marca)
Chelsea are ready to make a move for Bournemouth 's English midfielder Alex Scott, 23, in January. (Teamtalk)
Italy forward Federico Chiesa, 28, will look to leave Liverpool in January if he struggles for game time when he returns from injury. (Football Insider)
Former Manchester United and England winger Jadon Sancho, 26, is in talks with at least two Premier League clubs over a potential move. (Teamtalk)
AC Milan are preparing a move to sign Brazil forward Endrick, 20, on loan from Real Madrid in January. ( Calciomercato )
Manchester United remain keen to sign Leicester City midfielder Louis Page, 18, after missing out on a deadline-day move for the England youth international. ( ESPN )
Manchester City are keeping tabs on Atletico Madrid's Spain midfielder Alex Baena, but are unlikely to move for the 25-year-old in January. (Football Insider)
Liverpool and Manchester United have made direct contact with Wolves over a move for Portugal Under-21 winger Matheus Mane, 18. (Ekrem Konur)
Brentford have opened contract talks with 24-year-old Germany forward Kevin Schade to deter interest from Arsenal . (Teamtalk)
Manchester United have completed a deal to sign Liverpool 's 16-year-old English midfielder Isaac Konde. (Fabrizio Romano)

Chelsea want to secure the signing of Bournemouth 's highly-rated midfielder Alex Scott now, with a view to the 23-year-old arriving next summer, after having a £60m bid rejected in the recent transfer window. (Teamtalk)
Arsenal , Manchester City and Al-Hilal are interested in Chelsea winger Pedro Neto and could make a move for the 26-year-old Portugal international in the January transfer window. (Caught Offside)
Chelsea forward Christopher Nkunku, 28, turned down offers from Manchester United and Newcastle United before sealing a loan move back to RB Leipzig . (Bild & Sky Sport Germany via Caught Offside)

United States striker Folarin Balogun could move to the Saudi Pro League, where the transfer window is still open, with Monaco under financial pressure to sell the 25-year-old after he pulled out of a switch to Everton late on deadline day. (Football Insider)
Newcastle United attacking midfielder Jacob Murphy's contract runs out next summer but the 31-year-old Englishman could be offered a new deal at the Tyneside club. (Football Insider)
Former Chelsea winger Hakim Ziyech has parted ways with Wydad and the 33-year-old Moroccan has been linked with a move to Brazilian club Botafogo. (Goal)
England midfielder Curtis Jones, 25, says his chats with Inter Milan boss Cristian Chivu were key to him moving to the Italian club from Liverpool this summer. (Mirror)

Liverpool will consider making another move to sign Ismaila Sarr from Crystal Palace in January after failing to agree a deal for the 28-year-old Senegal winger before the summer deadline. (Football Insider)

Tottenham 's wantaway Brazil forward Richarlison will be hoping to seal a move to the Saudi Pro League, where signings are permitted up to 12 October, after failing to secure a switch to Trabzonspor before the transfer window closed in Turkey on Friday. (Standard)

Arsenal are closing in on agreeing a new contract with manager Mikel Arteta, whose current deal runs out at the end of this season as they also make progress on new deals for 27-year-old England midfielder Declan Rice, Norway playmaker Martin Odegaard, 27, and Dutch defender Jurrien Timber, 25. (Teamtalk)
Arsenal enquired about Germany winger Kevin Schade in the summer but moved on as Brentford had no intention of selling the 24-year-old. (Teamtalk)
Manchester United will continue to monitor Newcastle United left-back Lewis Hall, 21, with a view to a possible move for the England international next summer. (Football Insider)
Belgium midfielder Amadou Onana has signed a new deal, which runs until 2031, with Aston Villa . (Sacha Tavolieri)
AC Milan are still interested in Sporting defender Goncalo Inacio, 25, and could make a move for the Portugal international in the January transfer window. (Tuttomercatoweb - in Italian)

Manchester United remain in talks about signing English midfielder Louis Page from Leicester City after they failed to complete a move for the 18-year-old on transfer deadline day. (Manchester Evening News via Evening Standard)

Lyon considered bringing former France striker Karim Benzema back to the club but the 38-year-old's contract as an ambassador with the Saudi Pro League prevented him from making the move. (L'Equipe - in French)
Aston Villa and Sunderland were two of the clubs interested in French defender Matthieu Udol but Lens blocked the 30-year-old from leaving. (Foot Mercato, via Get French Football News)
Chelsea were offered former Mali midfielder Yves Bissouma, 30, who left Tottenham in the summer, as a replacement for Argentina's Enzo Fernandez, 25, who joined Manchester City for £125m. (Sun)

Manchester City and Chelsea are believed to be among those who showed an interest in signing England midfielder Adam Wharton, 22, before the transfer deadline, with Crystal Palace rejecting all bids. (Guardian)
Aston Villa , Manchester City and Newcastle United are showing interest in Spain winger Alex Baena but Atletico Madrid have no plans to sell the 25-year-old. (CaughtOffside)
Wolves could have sold Portugal Under-21s forward Mateus Mane before the transfer window closed, with Liverpool and Manchester United both admirers of the 18-year-old. (Teamtalk)
